Implementation done and green.

## What I changed

Two files, both in the plan's `files.change`:

**`src/features/cards/components/CardItem.tsx:42`** — the header and the type-tile branch (`body` on the plain card, `imageContent` on the image card) now sit inside one `<View testID="card-content">`, styled `[styles.cardContent, inactive ? styles.cardContentInactive : null]` (D-001, D-002, D-003). The group is built in the shared `content` element, so the `ImageBackground` and plain-`View` branches dim identically. The `testID="card-inactive"` wash is gone (D-004). The `Disconnected` badge and the `card-delete` Pressable stay as siblings *after* the group, at full opacity (D-006).

**`src/features/cards/components/CardItem.styles.ts`** — added `cardContent: { flex: 1, opacity: 1 }` and `cardContentInactive: { opacity: 0.5 }`; removed `inactiveOverlay` and, with it, the now-unused `StyleSheet` import (D-004, D-005).

`CardStack.tsx`, `CardsRepository.ts` and `useMonobankStore.ts` are byte-unchanged, per D-008, D-009 and D-010 — their suites were already green and stay green.

## Verification

Before the change, `CardItem.test.tsx` had 3 failures (AC-004, AC-014, and the badge/Delete-outside-the-group case) while the other four ticket suites passed — so the covering tests do depend on this code.

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean
- `npm run lint` (eslint + `checkTestConvention`) — clean
- `npx jest` — 30 suites, 204 tests, all passing

No test file was touched; nothing outside the plan's manifest was edited, so no `_amend-plan` was needed. One thing the tests cannot settle, already flagged as VG-001 in the test file's own header: whether 0.5 actually *reads* as a dead card, and whether the badge and Delete stay noticeable over the dimmed content, is a question for a built app — this round only establishes the number RN resolves on the group.
